svg.title: BOSS — text-only wordmark (v2)
svg.desc: "BOSS" set in heavy geometric sans (Helvetica Neue / Arial Black approximation pending licensed Druk Wide Super, Söhne Breit Kraftig, or Founders Grotesk Black), font-weight 900, charcoal #1F2937 on transparent. For text-only contexts where the integrated wordmark (with constellation O) isn't appropriate. The PRIMARY brand wordmark per v2 is the integrated version — see boss-integrated-wordmark.svg. v2 changes: typography shifts from Vollkorn old-style serif to heavy geometric sans; structure color shifts navy → charcoal. Brand v2 lock 2026-05-09.

text.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Arial Black, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
